examples.en: No pain, no gain.
examples.zh: 一份耕耘，一份收获。

examples.en: Online games are very interesting, but we can't spend too much time on them.
examples.zh: 网络游戏很有趣，但我们不能花太多时间。

examples.en: Football is a team game.
examples.zh: 足球是一项团队运动。

examples.en: The game lasted 2 hours.
examples.zh: 比赛进行了两个小时。

examples.en: How happily Little Tommy is playing with his cousin in the garden!
examples.zh: 小汤米和他的表弟在花园里玩耍多么快乐！

phrases: take up gardening 从事园艺

examples.en: A lot of gases are harmful.
examples.zh: 有许多气体是有害的。

examples.en: A friend of theirs is waiting for the manager at the gate of the company.
examples.zh: 他们的一个朋友正在公司门口等经理。

senses.zh: 大体的，笼统的；总的；全体的；普遍的

examples.en: This is the general trend.
examples.zh: 这是总体趋势。

examples.en: A soldier who doesn't want to be a general is not a good soldier.
examples.zh: 不想当将军的士兵不是好士兵。

examples.en: Some famous speeches in history have left a lasting impact on future generations.
examples.zh: 历史上一些著名的演讲对后世产生了深远的影响。

examples.en: She is a warmhearted, generous old lady.
examples.zh: 她是一位热心、慷慨的老太太。

examples.en: I want to play with the gentle cat.
examples.zh: 我想和那只温驯的猫玩耍。

examples.en: I am a gentleman.
examples.zh: 我是一个绅士。

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, we'll arrive in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 女士们、先生们，我们将到达上海。

examples.en: He picked the injured bird up gently.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地捡起受伤的小鸟。

notes:
gently 是常考单词，是由形容词 gentle 转换而来。学生一定要牢记在中考
考纲中有些形容词去 e 再加 y 即可转换为副词，如：possible—possibly(可能，
也许)，simple—simply(简单地)，terrible—terribly(可怕地)。

examples.en: Geography is an important subject.
examples.zh: 地理是一门很重要的学科。

senses.zh: 德国的；德国人的；德语的

examples.en: They are Germans, so they can speak German.
examples.zh: 他们是德国人，所以他们会说德语。

examples.en: Do you think the Germans clever?
examples.zh: 你认为德国人聪明吗？

examples.en: Shall we have lunch at the German restaurant?
examples.zh: 我们在德国餐厅吃午饭好吗？

notes:
German 是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记，German 的复数是 Germans；
human 的复数是 humans；walkman 的复数是 walkmans。

examples.en: Do you know what the population of Germany is?
examples.zh: 你知道德国的人口是多少？

_flags: OCR音标 /d3:meni/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'dʒɜːməni/

senses.zh: 成为；变得；得到；到达；（用于 have got 短语中）具有

examples.en: After taking tennis classes, Tim is getting much stronger than he was one year ago.
examples.zh: 上了网球课之后，蒂姆比一年前强壮多了。

examples.en:
— She looked unhappy today. What's wrong with her?
— She got a "D" in English.
examples.zh:
——她今天看上去不高兴。她怎么了？
——英语她得了一个“D”。

examples.en: I got to the station at half past four.
examples.zh: 我于4点半到达车站。

examples.en: Lucy has got a lovely pet dog. Its name is Taffy.
examples.zh: 露西有一条可爱的宠物狗。它的名字叫“太妃糖”。

phrases: get away 走开，离开；逃走
get into the habit of 养成……的习惯
get tired of 对……感到厌倦

examples.en: It's our family tradition to exchange gifts on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 在除夕夜交换礼物是我们家的传统。

examples.en: It was unusual for such a little girl to solve this hard problem in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 对于这样一个小女孩，在10分钟内就解决了这个棘手的问题，太不寻常了。

examples.en: What a useful suggestion you have given me!
examples.zh: 你给我的建议是多么有用啊！

examples.en: On leaving school, all the students felt thankful to the teachers for giving them a good education.
examples.zh: 离开学校时，所有的学生都感谢老师给了他们良好的教育。

examples.en: I am glad to hear from you.
examples.zh: 我很高兴收到你的来信。

examples.en: I will be glad to do it for you.
examples.zh: 我很乐意为你做这件事。

examples.en: It is said that eight glasses of water a day can help you keep fit.
examples.zh: 有人说，每天 8 杯水可以帮助你保持健康。

examples.en: The glasses are made of fine glass.
examples.zh: 眼镜是由优质玻璃制成的。

examples.en: Mike hurt one of his feet in an accident yesterday. Shall we go and see him after school?
examples.zh: 昨天的事故中迈克伤了一只脚。放学后我们去看看他好吗？

examples.en: I won't go to the party unless I'm invited.
examples.zh: 除非我受到邀请，否则我不会去参加聚会。

phrases: go for it 加油，大胆尝试
go hiking 去远足；去徒步旅行
go in for 参加；从事于；酷爱
go on a diet 节食
go on a picnic 去野营；去野餐
go on with/doing 继续做某事
go over 复习；仔细地再读一遍
go sailing 去航海，去航行
go to (the) hospital 去医院（看病）
go to the cinema/movies 去看电影
proverbs: Pride goes before a fall. 骄者必败。
notes:
go 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握 have gone to, have been to, have been in 的用法区别：
have gone to 意为“到某地去”，说话时该人不在现场，一般不用第一人称和第二人称代词作句子的主语。
例如：— Where is Jim? 吉姆在哪里？
— He has gone to England. 他去英国了。（尚未回来）
Mr. Wang isn't here. He has gone to Qingdao.
王先生不在这里。他去青岛了。
have been to 意为“曾经去过某地”，现在已不在那里了。后可接表示次数的词，
如 once, twice, three times 等，也可和 before, just, never, ever 等词连用。
例如：My father has been to Beijing twice. 我父亲去过北京两次。
I have never been to the Great Wall. 我从未去过长城。
have been in 表示“在某地待了多少时间”，句尾常接 for + 时间段，或 since +
时间点，或句首有 How long。
例如：I have been in Shanghai for three years. 我到上海已有 3 年了。

examples.en: Finally, Jack achieved his goal and became the owner of a company.
examples.zh: 最后，杰克实现了他的目标，成为了一家公司的老板。

examples.en: She kicked the ball into the net, scoring a goal for her team.
examples.zh: 她把球踢进球网，为球队得了分。

examples.en: Fire is the test of gold.
examples.zh: 真金不怕火炼。

examples.en: Her hair is golden.
examples.zh: 她的头发是金黄色的。

examples.en: Nadal is a good tennis player, but I think Djokovic is better.
examples.zh: 纳达尔是一名优秀的网球运动员，但我认为德约科维奇更优秀。

phrases: be good for 对……有好处
proverbs: All things in their being are good for something. 天生我材必有用。

examples.en: The government is going to widen the road this coming summer.
examples.zh: 政府打算今年夏天拓宽道路。

senses.zh: 等级；（中小学的）学年，年级；成绩，分数

examples.en: Kitty is in Grade Eight.
examples.zh: 姬蒂读八年级。

examples.en: He received a failing grade.
examples.zh: 他得了一个不及格的成绩。

examples.en: Mum has been working in this school since she graduated from university in 2000.
examples.zh: 妈妈自 2000 年大学毕业后就一直在这所学校工作。

examples.en: Li Fang is a graduate of Fudan University.
examples.zh: 李芳是一名复旦大学的毕业生。

examples.en: Does Jane often read newspapers to her 90-year-old grandma after school?
examples.zh: 放学后，简经常给她 90 岁的奶奶读报吗？

examples.en: My grandpa is so forgetful that he always leaves things about.
examples.zh: 我的爷爷很健忘，他总是到处丢东西。

examples.en: Wine is made from grapes.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒由葡萄酿制而成。

examples.en: She was very frightened at the sight of a snake on the grass.
examples.zh: 看到草地上的蛇，她很害怕。

senses.zh: 伟大的；重要的；〈口〉好极了，很好

examples.en: The great ship Titanic went down into the water and over 1,500 lives were lost.
examples.zh: 巨轮“泰坦尼克号”沉入水中，1500 多人失去了生命。

examples.en: We are very thankful to our teachers for their great help.
examples.zh: 我们非常感谢老师给予的巨大帮助。

examples.en: It is great for me to see her.
examples.zh: 看见她对我来说真好。

proverbs: Great hopes make great man. 远大的理想造就伟大的人物。

examples.en: Don't start moving the car until the traffic lights change to green.
examples.zh: 交通信号灯变绿之前，不要启动汽车。

examples.en: I like green grass.
examples.zh: 我喜欢青草。

examples.en: There are a lot of beans in the greenhouse.
examples.zh: 暖房里有许多豆子。

senses.zh: 问候；打招呼；欢迎；向……致敬

examples.en: When you first meet the interviewer, greet him or her politely.
examples.zh: 当你第一次见到面试官时，必须有礼貌地向他或她打招呼。

phrases: greet a teacher politely 礼貌地和老师打招呼

examples.en: Look out! There is a dead cat on the ground.
examples.zh: 小心！地上有一只死猫！

examples.en: The STEM course in our school requires students to do some projects in groups.
examples.zh: 我们学校的 STEM 课程要求学生分组完成一些项目。

senses.zh: 生长；发育；种植，栽种；逐渐变得；逐渐成为

examples.en: She has grown up.
examples.zh: 她长大了！

examples.en: Grandpa grew vegetables in his garden.
examples.zh: 爷爷在他的园子里种了蔬菜。

examples.en: As the days passed, her love for literature grew stronger.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，她对文学的热爱变得愈发强烈。

examples.en: I guess you are right.
examples.zh: 我想你是对的！

examples.en: His guess about the outcome of the game turned out to be correct.
examples.zh: 他对比赛结果的猜测是正确的。

examples.en: All the guests are pleased with the restaurant for its excellent service.
examples.zh: 所有的客人都对这家餐厅的优质服务表示满意。

examples.en: You can follow the guide.
examples.zh: 你可以跟着导游。

examples.en: Can you pass me the travel guide?
examples.zh: 你能将旅行指南递给我吗？

examples.en: The GPS system guided us safely to our destination in the unfamiliar city.
examples.zh: 在陌生的城市里，导航系统将我们安全引到了目的地。

examples.en: She was trying to teach him to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 她在试着教他弹吉他。

examples.en: Put the gun down!
examples.zh: 把枪放下！

examples.en: To improve your writing skills, you'd better develop a habit of reading.
examples.zh: 为了提高写作技巧，你最好养成阅读习惯。

examples.en: The beautiful girl has long hair.
examples.zh: 这个美丽的小女孩有一头长发。

examples.en: Joe spent nearly half a year planning his journey around the world.
examples.zh: 乔用了将近半年的时间来规划他的环球之旅。

examples.en: We will meet at half past four.
examples.zh: 我们将在4点半集合。

proverbs: Never do things by halves. 凡事不要半途而废。
notes:
half是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握以下表示“半小时或一个半小时”的固定搭配和数词的习惯用法。
half an hour 半小时
one hour and a half = one and a half hours 一个半小时
two hundred students = two hundred of the students 200 名学生
hundreds of students 许多学生，数百名学生
one-third of the students 三分之一的学生
two-thirds of the students 三分之二的学生
a ten-year-old boy 一个10 岁的男孩
The boy is ten years old. 这个男孩10 岁。
He is over fifty years old. 他已过了50 岁。
He is in his fifties. 他50 多岁了。
It's ten minutes' walk. = It's a ten-minute walk. 需要步行10 分钟。

examples.en: There was hardly anything interesting in today's party. We all left the hall early.
examples.zh: 今天的派对几乎没什么有趣的。我们都很早离开了会堂。

examples.en: Would you like to eat a hamburger?
examples.zh: 你想吃一个汉堡吗？

examples.en: Although Liu Wei has no hands, he can play the piano very beautifully.
examples.zh: 虽然刘伟没有手，但他能非常优美地弹奏钢琴。

examples.en: He handed me the glass.
examples.zh: 他把玻璃杯递给了我。

examples.en: Hand in please!
examples.zh: 请交上来！

phrases: give sb. a hand 助某人一臂之力
on the other hand 在另一方面

examples.en: He was the last man to be hanged for murder in this country.
examples.zh: 他是这个国家里最后一个因谋杀被处绞刑的人。

examples.en: The picture used to hang here and there are some marks on the wall.
examples.zh: 这幅画以前挂在这儿，墙上还有些痕迹呢。

_flags: OCR词形变化音标 hanged /'heind/ 有误，已修正为 hanged /hæŋd/

examples.en: The fight happened so quickly that nobody could describe the start and the finish of it.
examples.zh: 这场打斗发生得太快，以至于没人能描述它是怎么开始和结束的。

examples.en: They happened to see the famous Chinese tennis player at the airport yesterday.
examples.zh: 他们昨天碰巧在机场看到了那位著名的中国网球运动员。

phrases: happen to sb. 发生到某人身上
notes:
happen 是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记：happen = take place 没有被动语态。
例如：Billy neither knows nor cares what happened.
比利既不知道也不关心发生了什么事。

examples.en: Mary and Peter are playing happily.
examples.zh: 玛丽和彼得快乐地玩耍着。

examples.en: I want to live happily.
examples.zh: 我想生活幸福。

examples.en: Diligence is the path leading to happiness.
examples.zh: 勤劳是获得幸福的途径。

_flags: OCR音标 /'hæpmis/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'hæpinəs/

examples.en:
— Happy birthday! Here is a present for you.
— Thank you!
examples.zh:
——祝你生日快乐！这是送给你的礼物。
——谢谢！

examples.en: Every student in Grade Nine is studying hard to achieve more.
examples.zh: 为了获得更多的知识，九年级的每一位学生都在努力学习。

examples.en: It's hard to eat the hard bread.
examples.zh: 硬面包不好啃。

examples.en: Becoming a better person would not be hard if you follow all these instructions.
examples.zh: 如果你遵循这些指示，要成为一个更好的人是不难的。

examples.en: Linda, pass my glasses to me, please. I can hardly read the words in the newspaper.
examples.zh: 琳达，请把我的眼镜递给我。报纸上的字我几乎看不清。

examples.en: It hardly snows in Shanghai in winter, does it?
examples.zh: 上海的冬天几乎不下雪，是吗？

notes:
hardly 是常考单词，常出现在反义疑问句中，所以学生一定要知道：
1) 陈述部分含有 hardly, never, none, seldom, rarely, little, few, no, neither, nobody,
no one, nothing, too ... to ... 表示否定意义的词时，疑问部分要用肯定形式。
例如：The children seldom have any eggs for breakfast every morning, do they?
孩子们每天早餐几乎不吃鸡蛋，是吗？
2) 陈述部分含有否定前、后缀构成的词时，作肯定句处理，疑问部分要用否定
形式。
例如：He failed/disliked/disagreed ..., didn't he?
He is a man of few words, isn't he? 他是个沉默寡言的人，不是吗？
He is told not to ..., isn't he? 他被告知不要……，不是吗？
He is unhappy/dishonest, isn't he? 他不高兴/不诚实，不是吗？
3) 当陈述部分是 I think, I believe, I guess 等主句后跟 that 从句时(当主句的主语是第一人称)，疑问部分应该与从句保持一致，并且要注意否定的转移。
例如：I believe he will pass the exam, won't he?
我相信他会通过考试，不是吗？
I don't think he will pass the exam, will he?
我不认为他会通过考试，是吗？

examples.en: The Chinese nation is hardworking and brave.
examples.zh: 中华民族是勤劳勇敢的。

_flags: OCR音标 /ˈhaːdʌɪŋk/ 明显有误，已修正为 /ˌhɑːd'wɜːkɪŋ/

examples.en: Don't harm your eyes by reading in dim light.
examples.zh: 不要在昏暗的灯光下看书，以免损伤眼睛。

examples.en: It wouldn't do any harm to ask for advice.
examples.zh: 向别人征询建议是不会有任何害处的。

examples.en: The organisation has set strict rules on the release of harmful chemicals.
examples.zh: 该组织对有害化学品的排放制定了严格的规定。

examples.en: The red hat is too small to wear.
examples.zh: 这顶红帽子太小了，不能戴。

examples.en: I hate to see posers showing off.
examples.zh: 我最恨看装腔作势的人一副卖弄的样子。

examples.en: Dad sometimes goes to the supermarket with us though he hates going shopping.
examples.zh: 爸爸虽然讨厌购物，但有时会和我们一起去超市。

examples.en: I was seventeen and filled with a lot of hate.
examples.zh: 我那时 17 岁，满腔仇恨。

examples.en: I have something important to discuss with Tim. I will wait for Tim until he gets back.
examples.zh: 我有一些重要的事情要与蒂姆讨论。我会一直等到他回来。

examples.en: Could you tell me when we will have a meeting?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我，我们什么时候开会吗？

examples.en: She had a fever last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚发烧了。

notes:
have 是常考使役动词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法：
have sb. do sth. 使某人做某事
have sth. done = ask sb. to do sth. 请某人做某事

examples.en: We've never seen a more amazing creature. It has no head but is alive.
examples.zh: 我们从没见过比这更令人惊异的生物。它没有头，但是活的。

examples.en: I have a terrible headache.
examples.zh: 我头痛得厉害。

examples.en: The headline is important.
examples.zh: 大标题很重要。

_flags: OCR音标 /'hedlam/ 明显有误，已修正为 /'hedlaɪn/

examples.en: The headmaster gave a wonderful speech despite the rain.
examples.zh: 校长冒雨发表了一场精彩的演讲。

examples.en: Smoking is harmful to our health.
examples.zh: 吸烟有害健康。

examples.en: Healthy eating and doing exercise every day can keep us fit.
examples.zh: 健康饮食和每天运动能让我们保持健康。

examples.en: Can you speak louder, please? I can't hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 你可以大声一点吗？我听不清楚。

examples.en:
— Billy lost his bike yesterday and had to walk home.
— Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
examples.zh:
——昨天比利的自行车丢了，他只好步行回家。
——哦，听到这个消息我很抱歉。

examples.en: We heard two people arguing when we walked past that area.
examples.zh: 当我们走过那个地方的时候，听到两人正在争论。

notes:
hear 是常考感官动词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法：
1) hear sb. doing sth. 指动作正在进行当中。
例如：I hear him talking next door. 我听到他正在隔壁房间讲话。
2) hear sb. do sth. 指动作已发生，完成了，也就是说听到整个过程。意思是“听到某人做了某事”，动作不再呈现。
例如：Would you ask her to sing a song for us? We'd like to hear her sing like a soprano.
你能让她为我们唱一首歌吗？我们喜欢听她像女高音那样唱。
3) 大多数的感官动作 (see, watch, notice 等) 都可以用于这两种结构，但要注意加以区别。用 v-ing，表示动作正在进行，即处于发生的过程中，还没有结束；
用不定式则表示全过程，或经常性的动作，或过去的动作。
试比较：Do you hear someone knocking at the door? (讲时还在敲)
I heard someone knock at the door three times. (讲时敲的动作已结束)

examples.en: I will remember you in my heart.
examples.zh: 我将把你记在心中。

examples.en: The sun gives off heat.
examples.zh: 太阳散发出热量。

examples.en: The stove heats the room.
examples.zh: 暖炉使房间暖和起来。

_flags: OCR音标 /hɪt/ 明显有误，已修正为 /hiːt/

examples.en: The gentleman lost his temper for the first time and shut the door heavily when he left.
examples.zh: 这位绅士第一次发了脾气。他离开时重重地关上了门。

examples.en: How heavy is that typewriter? = What is the typewriter's weight?
examples.zh: 那台打字机有多重？

examples.en: Jim is of average height in our class, but he is still taller than Tommy.
examples.zh: 吉姆在我们班身高中等，但他仍比汤米高。

examples.en: Hello, how are you?
examples.zh: 喂，你好吗？

examples.en: Can you help me to get some help?
examples.zh: 你能帮我找人帮个忙吗？

examples.en: Professor Wang personally thanked everyone who helped with the project.
examples.zh: 王教授亲自向所有为这个项目提供过帮助的人表示了感谢。

examples.en: The students have recently finished their group project with the teacher's help.
examples.zh: 在老师的帮助下，同学们最近完成了他们的小组课题。

phrases: help sb. with sth. 帮助某人做某事
with the help of 在……的帮助下

examples.en: But have you ever heard of a forest fire that can be helpful for a forest?
examples.zh: 但你有没有听说过森林火灾有助于森林生态的发展呢？

examples.en: The Greeks were glad to find the wooden horse was helpful in capturing the city.
examples.zh: 希腊人很高兴地发现这匹木马对攻占这座城市很有帮助。

examples.en: The mother felt so helpless when she knew her child was seriously ill.
examples.zh: 当这位母亲得知自己的孩子病得很重时，她感到非常无助。

examples.en: I was born here. I'm quite familiar with the streets in this town.
examples.zh: 我出生在这里。我对这个小镇的街道相当熟悉。

examples.en: Though they are really great, they have never thought of themselves as heroes.
examples.zh: 虽然他们真的很伟大，但他们从来没有认为是英雄。

examples.en: I'm still hesitating.
examples.zh: 我仍然在犹豫。

examples.en: The boy hid in the tree.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩躲在树里。

examples.en: Nowadays the oil price in the world is getting much higher than before.
examples.zh: 如今世界上的石油价格比以前高得多。

examples.en: Shanghai Tower is one of the highest buildings in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 上海中心大厦是上海最高建筑物之一。

examples.en: I got out of breath running up the hill from the station.
examples.zh: 我从车站跑上山顶，连气都喘不上来了。

examples.en: The book is based on historical events.
examples.zh: 这本书是根据历史事件写成的。

derivations.zh: 历史上著名的；历史上重要的

examples.en: Southwold, a seaside town in England, has a history of more than thirteen centuries.
examples.zh: 索思沃尔德，一个英国海边的小镇，有1300多年的历史。

senses.zh: 打，撞，击中，碰撞；达到(某水平)

examples.zh: 你打了我的头。

examples.en: The company's sales hit a record high last quarter.
examples.zh: 公司上季度的销售额达到了历史新高。

examples.en: You know Mike's hobby is playing football, but mine is collecting stamps.
examples.zh: 你知道迈克的爱好是踢足球，但我的爱好是集邮。

senses.zh: 拿；抱；握住；举行；进行；保持；容纳；使……保持在某位置

examples.en: I can hold the baby.
examples.zh: 我能抱这个小孩。

examples.en: The Eighth China International Import Expo was held successfully in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 第八届中国国际进口博览会在上海成功举办。

examples.en: This hall can hold more than one hundred people.
examples.zh: 这个大厅可以容纳100多人。

examples.en: She held the door open for her friend as they entered the building.
examples.zh: 进楼的时候她为朋友们把着门。

phrases: hold a meeting 举行会议
hold on 等一等(别挂电话)
hold one's breath 屏住呼吸

examples.en: The hole is too small, I cannot push my arm through.
examples.zh: 这个洞太小了, 我的胳膊伸不过去。

examples.en:

——太好了!

senses.zh: 在家; 到家; 回家

examples.en: Frank works with others from home through computers.
examples.zh: 弗兰克在家里通过电脑与其他人联系办公。

examples.en: We have spent all our money, so we have to walk home now.
examples.zh: 我们已经花光了所有的钱, 所以现在不得不步行回家。

examples.en: The earthquake in that country left thousands of people homeless.
examples.zh: 发生在那个国家的地震使成千上万的人无家可归。

examples.en: He returned to his hometown in the spring of 1917.
examples.zh: 他在 1917 年的春天回到了家乡。

examples.en: Don't go out of the classroom until your homework is finished.
examples.zh: 做完家庭作业前不准离开教室。

senses.zh: 诚实的; 正直的; 坦率的

examples.en: Children are educated to be honest when they are very young.
examples.zh: 在孩子们还很小的时候, 就要教育他们诚实。

examples.en: Honesty is the most important thing for a person.
examples.zh: 对一个人来说，诚实是最重要的。

senses.zh: 蜂蜜；(爱称) 亲爱的；宝贝

examples.en: I like to eat honey.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃蜂蜜。

examples.en: “Good morning, honey,” Mum said with a smile. “
examples.zh: 早上好，宝贝。”妈妈笑着说。

examples.en: It is an honour for me to be chosen as a group leader of our class project.
examples.zh: 被选为我们班级项目的组长，对我来说是一种荣誉。

examples.en: If we don't give up hope, we will surely succeed.
examples.zh: 如果我们不放弃希望，我们一定会成功的。

examples.en: I hope you will succeed.
examples.zh: 我希望你能成功。

examples.en: I hope to hear from you.
examples.zh: 我希望收到你的来信。

proverbs: Where there is life, there is hope. 生命不息，希望常在。

senses.zh: 满怀希望的；抱有希望的；表现出希望的；给人以希望的

examples.en: Surgeons were hopeful of saving the sight in Sara's left eye.
examples.zh: 外科医生有望保住萨拉的左眼视力。

examples.en: My sister felt so sad to find that it was hopeless to clean her favourite T-shirt.
examples.zh: 我妹妹难过地发现，清洗干净她最喜欢的 T 恤衫是没指望了。

examples.en: His face is horrible.
examples.zh: 他的脸很恐怖。

examples.en: When the horse finished the race, its sides were wet all over with sweat.
examples.zh: 当这匹马跑完比赛，它浑身上下都是汗水。

examples.en: The doctors in that hospital always examine patients with great care.
examples.zh: 该院医生总是细心地为患者检查身体。

senses.zh: 主人；节目主持人 (hostess /ˈhəʊstəs/ n. 女主人；女节目主持人)

examples.en: I'm the host of the house.
examples.zh: 我是这间房子的主人。

examples.en: He's the host.
examples.zh: 他是主持人。

examples.en: In such hot weather, people live comfortably with air conditioners.
examples.zh: 在如此炎热的天气里，空调使人们生活舒适。

examples.en: This curry is very hot.
examples.zh: 这咖喱特别辣。

examples.en: I like to eat hot dog.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃热狗。

examples.en: The Magic Hotel is amazing because it's completely underwater.
examples.zh: 魔术酒店很奇妙，因为它完全在水下。

examples.en: Thanks to Mrs. Lin! With her help, we finished our work an hour earlier.
examples.zh: 谢谢林太太！在她的帮助下，我们提前一个小时完成了工作。

examples.en: What good news it is! The government is planning to build more low-cost houses for its people.
examples.zh: 政府正计划为本国人民建造更多低价住房。真是好消息啊！

examples.en:
— Would you like me to help you with the housework?
— That's very kind of you.
examples.zh:
——我帮你做家务好吗？
——你真好。

senses.zh: (方法、手段、状态) 怎样；如何；(程度、数量、价钱) 多少；(感叹) 多么

examples.en: I really don't know how to answer your question.
examples.zh: 我真的不知道该如何回答你的问题。

examples.en: How about having a picnic?
examples.zh: 去野餐如何？

examples.en: How long did Tom spend finding the answer?
examples.zh: 汤姆花了多长时间才找到这个答案？

examples.en: How often do you go for a swim, once a week or twice a week?
examples.zh: 你多久去游一次泳，是每周一次还是每周两次？

examples.en: How well she sings!
examples.zh: 她唱得多好啊！

notes:
how 是常考单词，常出现在对划线部分提问的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握 how, what, where, why, which 等词的转换用法：
划线划在 twice a year 上，用 How often 提问
划线划在 twice 上，用 How many times 提问
划线划在 for twenty minutes 上，用 How long 提问
划线划在 until 8 o'clock 上，用 How long 提问
划线划在 since 1918 上，用 How long 提问
划线划在 in 1918 上，用 When 提问
划线划在 in twenty minutes 上，用 How soon 提问
划线划在 at 7 o'clock 上，用 What time 提问
划线划在 fifty miles an hour 上，用 How fast 提问
划线划在 fifty minutes' walk 上，用 How far 提问
划线划在 English 上，用 What language 提问
划线划在 English or Chinese 上，用 Which language 提问
划线划在 to do 上表示目的，用 Why 或 What ... for 提问
划线划在 on the tenth floor 上，用 Where 或 Which floor do you live on? 或 On which floor 提问
划线划在 5 dollars 上，用 How much is ...?/How much does ... cost?/What's the price of ...? 句型提问

examples.en: However hard he tries, he never succeeds.
examples.zh: 无论他多么努力尝试，都没能成功。

examples.en: However, modern technology has changed all that.
examples.zh: 然而，现代技术已经改变了所有这一切。

examples.en: He greeted her with a loving hug.
examples.zh: 他以一个深情的拥抱来迎接她。

examples.en: It's common to hug when people meet in the US.
examples.zh: 在美国，见面拥抱是件很平常的事。

senses.zh: 巨大的，庞大的；极多的；程度高的

examples.en: This is really a huge amount of money, but it is much less than we need.
examples.zh: 这实在是一笔巨款，但跟我们所需的还差得很远。

examples.en: Her greatness lies in her deep understanding of human nature.
examples.zh: 她的伟大之处在于她对人性的深刻了解。

examples.en: Whatever is done has to be done by humans.
examples.zh: 一切事情都是要人去做的。

examples.en: This new book brings together a few stories in a humorous way.
examples.zh: 这本新书以幽默的方式把一些故事串联在一起。

examples.en: The animals can go hungry because their food has been damaged in the forest fire.
examples.zh: 因为食物在这次森林火灾中遭到破坏，所以动物们可能要挨饿了。

examples.en: I've hunted everywhere but I can't find it.
examples.zh: 我到处都找遍了，就是找不到。

examples.en: When I hurried to the cinema, the film had been on for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 当我匆匆赶到电影院时，电影已经开始 10 分钟了。
examples.rewrite: When I went to the cinema in a hurry, the film had been on for ten minutes.

examples.en: Hurry up, or you won't catch the early bus.
examples.zh: 快点，否则你就赶不上早班车了。

examples.en: I am in a hurry.
examples.zh: 我很急。

senses.zh: 伤害(身体、感情等)；痛；使受伤痛；使烦恼

examples.en: If you feel that it hurts you, it will probably hurt the rest too.
examples.zh: 如果你觉得它伤害了你，它也可能会伤害其他人。

examples.en: Be careful not to touch the hot water, or you will get hurt.
examples.zh: 小心别碰热水，否则你会受伤的。

examples.en: I love my husband.
examples.zh: 我爱我的丈夫。

examples.en: It is made of ice.
examples.zh: 它是由冰做的。

examples.en: I like to eat ice cream.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃冰淇淋。

examples.en: The idea to go to Shanghai Chenshan Botanical Garden sounds wonderful.
examples.zh: 去上海辰山植物园，这个主意好极了。

senses.zh: (连接状语从句) 如果，假使；(连接宾语从句) 是否，是不是

examples.en: I won’t go to Kitty’s birthday party if she doesn’t invite me.
examples.zh: 如果姬蒂不邀请我，我不会去她的生日聚会。
examples.rewrite: I won’t go to Kitty’s birthday party unless she invites me.

examples.en: You won’t have a chance to win the contest if you don’t prepare enough.
examples.zh: 如果你准备不充分，就没有机会赢得比赛。

examples.en: I don’t know if he will come tomorrow, if he comes, please call me.
examples.zh: 我不知道他明天是否会来，如果他来了，请打电话给我。

examples.en: I want to know if he is friendly.
examples.zh: 我想知道他是否友善。

notes:
if是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握以下句型的用法：
if句式=祈使句+and句式=否定祈使句+or句式。
例如：If you work hard, you will get high marks.
= Work hard, and you will get high marks.
努力学习，你就会得高分。
If you stay up too late, you will fall ill.
= Don’t stay up too late, or you will fall ill.
不要熬太晚，否则你会生病的。

examples.en: The government had ignored his views on the subject.
examples.zh: 政府忽视了他对这一问题的看法。

examples.en: John is seriously ill, so you ought to spend more time caring for him these days.
examples.zh: 约翰病得很重，所以这些天你应该多花些时间照顾他。

senses.zh: (身体或精神上的) 疾病，病

examples.en: Don't worry about my illness; what I need is nothing but a few days' rest.
examples.zh: 不要为我的病担心，我只要休息几天就好了。

examples.en: Can you imagine living on Mars one day?
examples.zh: 你能想象有朝一日在火星上生活的场景吗？

examples.en: I'll do it immediately.
examples.zh: 我马上就做。

notes:
immediately 是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，
所以学生一定要知道：immediately 与 at once/right away/in no time 意思相同，在
句中可以互换。
例如：After seeing the message I left on the desk, Mr. Wang called back immediately.
= After seeing the message I left on the desk, Mr. Wang called back at once/
right away/in no time. 看到桌上我留下的信息后，王先生马上回了电话。

examples.en: More and more people have realised the importance of saving water.
examples.zh: 越来越多的人已经意识到了节约水的重要性。

examples.en: It's important to keep as many cultural traditions as possible.
examples.zh: 尽可能多地保留文化传统很重要。

examples.zh: 对于一个几乎没有经验的人来说，要在两天内完成这项工作是不可能的。

examples.zh: 不要用红墨水做练习。

examples.zh: 浦东国际机场是世界上最大的机场之一。

examples.en: It must be fantastic if more students join in the charity show tomorrow.

notes:
join 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法。join 与 attend, enter
for, join in, take part in 都有“参加”的意思，学生需知道它们的用法区别：
join 指加入某个组织、团体，并成为其中一员，也可用于表示加入某人做某事。
例如：She joined the club two years ago. 她两年前加入了这个俱乐部。
Will you join us for dinner? 你愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗？
attend 常用于表示参加会议、婚礼、讲座、课程等较为正式的活动，强调出席这一动作。
例如：He will attend an important meeting tomorrow. 他明天将参加一个重要会议。
enter for 主要用于表示报名参加竞赛、考试等活动。
例如：Visitors can enter for a guided tour of the museum.
游客可以报名参加博物馆的导览活动。
join in 更强调加入到他人正在进行的活动中的，通常指小规模的活动，可与 take part in 互换。
例如：Can I join in the game? 我能加入这个游戏吗？
take part in 侧重于参加活动并在其中发挥作用、承担角色，通常用于参加会议、比赛、活动等。
例如：They will take part in the volunteer activities this weekend.
他们将参加本周末的志愿者活动。
